preamble: Backing of the labiodental fricative /f/ to a velar fricative [x] is a regional change found in two well-described settings. In Southern Russian dialects, which historically lacked native /f/, /f/ is replaced by [x] or by the clusters [xv]~[xw]. In Andalusian and some Latin American Spanish, /f/ before the labial glide /w/ is realized as an aspirate or a velar fricative (fuerte, fuego, fuimos), the labial glide having absorbed the labiality of the fricative.

examples.note: Isogloss separating Southern Russian from Standard and Northern Russian; the cluster variants [xv]~[xw] also replace /f/ (cf. Belarusian хварту́к 'apron' beside Russian фартук).
Before /w/, /f/ is articulated as an aspirate or a velar fricative in Andalusia and parts of Spanish America.

sources: Wikipedia contributors. Evolution of Latin /f/ in Spanish. https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Evolution_of_Latin_/f/_in_Spanish
